text:
sara: FYI — incoming case from AcmeCorp. Mid-cycle downgrade, PO required on invoice, primary card declined, second card charged but got disputed. They’re asking for a partial credit + corrected VAT lines. account id ACME-42 :grimacing:

liam: ugh. Do we have the invoice id? need to see tax breakdown and what the charging flow did.

sara: invoice 2026-AC-7789, PO# PO-9988 attached to the account metadata. Billing bot shows a capture on card2 and a decline on card1. customer says they need a proration credit for the unused portion (downgrade happened 2026-04-09). VAT was applied on full invoice, they claim VAT should be split between refundable portion and used portion.

maya: can someone reproduce the calculation locally? I worry our proration logic treats VAT as a top-level line and then applies credit which leads to imbalance. :eyes:

jordan: quick checklist: 1) confirm subscription proration window 2) compute gross credit 3) split tax proportionally 4) issue credit note referencing PO 5) refund if capture happened on charged card.

anna: pinging @liam — can you pull the invoice JSON from the billing API and paste the tax lines?

liam: sure, running curl now.

liam: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_API_KEY" \ 
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoices/2026-AC-7789" | jq '.lines, .taxes'
```

liam: response snippet:
```json
{
  "lines": [
    { "id": "sub-monthly", "amount": 12000, "description": "Pro plan monthly", "period": "2026-04-01 to 2026-05-01" }
  ],
  "taxes": [
    { "type": "VAT", "amount": 2400, "rate": 0.2 }
  ]
}
```

maya: ok so VAT is a single line (2400). If they downgrade on 2026-04-09, unused days = 22 of 30 -> credit = 12000 * (22/30) = 8800 gross. Tax portion should be 8800 * 0.2 = 1760. But our current credit builder created a credit note for 8800 and left VAT untouched (so ledger mismatch).

sara: that matches what the customer reported. We need to issue a credit note that includes both the negative subscription line and a negative tax line, and reference PO-9988 on the credit document. Also they want the credit applied to the charged card (card2) and the disputed charge on card1 to be left pending until dispute resolves.

jordan: ops-oncall — is there any automated flow that blocked creating tax line credits for draft credit notes when PO is present? I remember a guard related to external billing partners.

ops-oncall: I’ll check logs. My suspicion: when invoice has a PO, our credit-notes flow marks the invoice as "non-refundable until PO approval" and skipped auto-tax-calculation. That’s a bug: PO should not change tax math, just approval flow.

billing-bot: [automated] Created draft credit note CN-2026-AC-441 for invoice 2026-AC-7789 (status: draft)

liam: repro steps for devs: 1) create subscription, 2) issue invoice, 3) simulate mid-cycle downgrade at day 9, 4) attach PO meta to invoice, 5) call POST /v1/credit_notes with proration=true. In our env the API returned 201 but taxes array was empty.

liam: snippet of payload I used:
```json
{
  "invoice_id": "2026-AC-7789",
  "prorate": true,
  "apply_to_payment": false,
  "metadata": { "po": "PO-9988" }
}
```

maya: thanks. If we need a hotfix for customers, we should: a) compute expected tax line (1760) b) patch credit note to add tax line c) create refund on card2 for net amount 7040? Wait compute: captured was full invoice total = 14400. Credit gross 8800 with tax 1760 -> net credit 7040. So refund 7040 to card2. Create CN with negative lines: -8800 sub, -1760 VAT, reference PO.

sara: confirm numbers with finance ledger before issuing refunds. Also add note: "Do not refund card1" since that charge is disputed.

anna: I'll draft the credit note description: "Partial proration credit for mid-cycle downgrade (2026-04-09). Associated PO: PO-9988. VAT split applied proportionally."

jordan: next steps assign: @liam create a fix that ensures tax lines are generated even when invoice.metadata.po exists; @anna create the CN text and ask for manual approval; @sara confirm ledger account and issue refund after finance sign-off.

liam: on it. Quick patch idea: in CreditNoteBuilder.generate() remove early-return that skips tax recompose when invoice.metadata contains "po". I’ll open a tiny PR and request urgent review.

ops-oncall: I found the guard in billing-core/src/credit_notes/approval_helpers.rb line 78. Reproduced locally, adding the tax line manually fixes balance.

billing-bot: [automated] PR opened: billing/patch/ensure-tax-lines-for-po (#3742) by liam — review requested

sara: Thanks folks. @maya can you coordinate with CS to tell AcmeCorp we’re preparing a credit note and potential refund to the charged card; give ETA ~4 hours pending finance sign-off. Use this message as the incident note. :thumbsup:

maya: will do. adding to the case now and cc'ing support lead.

liam: once PR merges, test plan: 1) new credit note creation with PO -> tax lines present 2) ledger balanced (debits = credits) 3) refund API called for correct net amount 4) CN PDF includes PO number and explanation

anna: saved steps into the ticket. tagging: TAX, FINANCE, CS.

sara: closing loop — after refund, update the invoice metadata: { "credit_note": "CN-2026-AC-441", "refund_tx": "RF-2026-9001" } and notify customer.

liam: will follow up in thread once PR/deploy done.

maya: thanks everyone :heart:

billing-bot: [automated] CN-2026-AC-441 status -> approved (by finance)

sara: refund initiated RF-2026-9001 -> amount 7040 to card ending 4242. Customer notified. Thread resolved.
